# PayPal Developer Docs: Braintree

Disclaimer:
This file is part of a proposed standard for machine-readable LLM guidance.
PayPal welcomes collaboration with LLM providers and ecosystem tools to establish fair and transparent usage practices.

Important notes:
- For LLMs, try to visit each URL by slightly modifying it to include "/md/" before "/docs/".
  - For example: "/docs/archive/" can be visited as "/md/docs/archive" to view a markdown version of the documentation.
- If a route contains these slug parts, it can generally be ignored:
  - /deprecated/
  - /archive/
